edits.before: Chip the ledger and bank the souls — the collection out-scales every support item.
edits.after: Soul-fragment sustain from Ravenous Flock starts tanking your poke, tipping this stage his way.

edits.before: Dawning Shadow online — the global beam saves dives and finishes recalls.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension plus a landed Nevermove pull gives him a real all-in kill window.

edits.before: First item: the Q chunks and the soul thresholds start mocking trade math.
edits.after: His drain-tank sustain out-heals your poke until you land anti-heal.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: Stacked crit and global R burst him down before Ascension ramps, keeping you outside his pull.

edits.before: - Swain Nevermove: matchup-defining — The root that decides — dodge it and the general farms regret. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Curse of the Black Mist banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Nevermove (E) is down 12s at rank 1, falling to 10s at rank 5 — dodge it and he has no reliable engage. Ravenous Flock (P) bypasses stacking resistances, so buy anti-heal instead of raw armor.

edits.before: A poke mirror your sustain tilts — Q heals through his chip and the souls out-scale his rotation.
edits.after: He pokes and drains — dodge Nevermove, poke his soul stacks down, and buy anti-heal before Demonic Ascension ramps.

edits.before: Heal through the poke war and out-infinite the mage. Shorthand: Nevermove spent, duo synced, go.
edits.after: Win before 6: bait Nevermove, poke through it, and starve his soul fragments so Demonic Ascension has nothing to drain.

edits.before: Swain wins by landing Nevermove, denying your pattern, and owning the chip ledger and the tempo it buys.
edits.after: Swain wins by landing Nevermove, banking soul-fragment sustain off your poke, and forcing an Ascension all-in once his health outgrows yours.

edits.before: - Senna vs Swain - Track: Swain Nevermove. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Nevermove is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.
edits.after: - Senna vs Swain - Track: Nevermove (E) cooldown, 12s down to 10s. - Ravenous Flock bypasses resistances — buy anti-heal, not armor. - Demonic Ascension plus a landed pull is his real all-in. - Global R punishes any Swain overextend.

edits.before: Ramp Ascension healing off you and your ADC in extended fights
edits.after: Land Demonic Ascension to heal off you and your ADC in extended fights
